类 PrintStreamSink

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.PrintStreamSink
所有已实现的接口:
ProgressSink, AutoCloseable
public final class PrintStreamSink extends Object implements ProgressSink
Writes each rendered frame to a PrintStream using print or println, whichever fits your output pipeline.

Unlike ConsoleSink, this never moves the cursor: one frame is one write. It is the right choice when the host application owns the stream, e.g. a redirected console, a test harness, or a custom writer.
